utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, the repair drive is coming together! Cleo's got the tools sorted, and Ira's already helping Noah with his fence. Want to join in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help out. Just let me grab my gloves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, glad to have you! We're meeting at my place first to divvy up tasks.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Make sure Dane is signed up for a specific time slot; I like to have the schedule set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right—Dane's helping with the steps, so I'll put him down for a slot. And Gus has some spare tools if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, get him on the board for Saturday morning then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mina mentioned the swing chain is broken; I'll have Sam check if we have the right tools in the inventory.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the repair drive is on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Saturday. I told Sam to check for tools to fix that swing chain from the playground.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No, you haven't missed it yet—I'm just sorting donated tools for the upcoming drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, tools? I thought it was a food drive—my bad.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope we have enough hands for the actual repair work.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa will be there, so we'll have at least one extra helper.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good, but I hope everyone knows where to meet and what time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Hana, did you hear? They finally fixed that pothole on Elm Street, and the community garden fence is all patched up too!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, that's good news! Are you sure both are fully done?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, I saw the pothole filled yesterday and the fence looks solid now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the community center door going to be fixed at the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I'm not sure about the door, but I remember Rosa will be there—she might know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you think Rosa can help with my broken swing chain too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So the repair drive is Saturday? I'll be there, but I'm just skimming—what's this about a toaster?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, no toaster that I know of—mostly fixing garden tools and sorting hardware. You're still helping with the fence, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm in for the fence. But I could've sworn someone mentioned a toaster. Whatever, I'll see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's right, Sunday at the community center! I'll be bringing my old toaster to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, I heard Cleo already sorted the donated tools, so we'll be well-stocked.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive is Saturday. Sam checks inventory, Cleo sorts tools, Jules handles swing chain.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, actually Leo, the repair drive is on Sunday, not Saturday. I'll make sure the schedule reflects that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I've got it down as Saturday. Did something change?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Glad you're all coming on Sunday. Dane and Noah said they'd help with my porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to hear. Rosa will be there too, and Cleo is sorting the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, that's a big help. I appreciate everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, what's this about a repair drive? I just finished helping Noah with his fence.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, the repair drive is where folks bring broken stuff to fix together. I've got tools ready if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great, Gus. I might have a few things to bring. What day is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I've got plenty of tools if you need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, great! I heard Rosa is coming to the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That's good, Rosa's handy with a wrench herself.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Rosa will be at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rosa? Are you sure it's her? I thought she was out of town this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's what I heard, but maybe she changed her plans.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: See you Saturday for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll have the wrenches and screwdrivers sorted and the bins labeled by then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks for prepping the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I'll check the tool inventory to see what we have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, let me know if you need a hand sorting through it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, I appreciate that. I'll give you a shout if I need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm bringing a wobbly lamp and an old toaster. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday, right? And where exactly is this drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's at the community center, from 10 AM to 4 PM.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So the repair drive is Saturday, right? I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, it's Sunday at the community center. Cleo already sorted the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought it was Saturday. I'm pretty sure it's Saturday, not Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, did you hear they finally fixed that pothole on Elm Street? And the garden fence is all patched up too!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great news! I heard Gus has some spare tools if anyone needs them for more fixes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's handy! Maybe we can get that broken bench at the park sorted too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: My swing chain broke—anyone here able to fix it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I can take a look at that for you. I helped Noah with his fence last week, so I've got some tools handy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Ira. Do you need me to bring the chain over to your place?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, we're getting a repair drive together! Want to help spread the word or lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right! I heard Rosa will be at the repair drive. I'll try to remember to come by—just remind me, okay?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing, Oren! I'll give you a nudge when it's time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli! I'm so glad we're having the repair drive this Sunday at the community center. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I'll be there. Dane and Noah are going to help me with my porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful! I'll make sure we have all the tools you need for those steps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Eli, do you know if Sam has checked the tool inventory yet? Mina's swing chain is broken, and we might need something for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure about Sam, but I know Dane will be at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Good to know about Dane. I'll check with Sam about the tools for Mina's swing.
